 Emanuele Tramacere GOAL Emanuele Tramacere Follow Lecce v Genoa, a match in the 10th round of Serie A
 Lecce and Genoa meet at the Stadio Via del Mare in the capital of Salento at 18:00 for the penultimate match of Sunday’s 10th round of Serie A 2026/27. Eusebio Di Francesco’s Lecce are battling an injury crisis after a heavy defeat in Frosinone and are seeking vital points in their fight for survival. Daniele De Rossi’s Genoa bounced back with an emphatic 2-0 home win over Juventus, but have yet to pick up a point away from home.
